text:
Osaka has three Christmas markets this December: a free one in a park with 24 shops, one under a 25-metre LED tree, and one on a department-store floor with a merry-go-round. Here's which one fits your evening 👇

🎯 Guess which one has a Santa House this year, then check 👉 https://japanbystation.com/osaka-christmas-markets-2026

We checked every date and hour on the official pages before writing this.

🎄 THE THREE MARKETS

1️⃣ Tenshiba, Tennoji Park. Free entry, 20 Nov–25 Dec, 11:00–21:00 (21:30 from 19 Dec). Three giant trees, a tunnel of lights, and hot drinks ¥100 cheaper in the market mug.

2️⃣ Umeda Sky Building. Free to walk in, 13 Nov–25 Dec, 12:00–22:00. A tree of about 25 m with around 130,000 LEDs; in December the main light show runs every half hour from 17:00 to 21:30.

3️⃣ Hankyu Umeda, 9th floor. About 120 brands including German ornaments, an 8 m mirror-ball tree with a show on the hour, and a ¥350 merry-go-round you book online.

📅 WORTH KNOWING

Hankyu's event-hall section ends on 20 December. Santa from Rovaniemi visits Hankyu on 19–20 December only.

Our take: Tenshiba for the full market night, Umeda Sky if you only have one evening near Osaka Station.
